columns.rationale: Invoice identifier with null_rate 0.0 and 2330 distinct values; samples such as '489434' are digit strings but this is an identifier, so it stays VARCHAR rather than being cast to a numeric type.
Product code with null_rate 0.0 and 3141 distinct values; samples mix digits and letters ('10002R', '10123C'), so the column stays text; renamed to snake_case stock_code.

Free-text product description with 228 nulls (null_rate 0.005041) retained as null; samples show leading/trailing whitespace (' ANIMAL STICKERS', ' BROWN  PIRATE TREASURE CHEST ') which is preserved as landed.
Landed as DECIMAL(38,9) with null_rate 0.0, but every sample is integral (-1395.0, -720.0, -504.0) and min -1395.0 / max 5184.0 fit INTEGER, so the cast is safe; negative values indicate returns.

Derived flag set true when quantity is negative; the profile shows min -1395.0 and all ten samples negative (-1395.0 through -504.0), evidence that return/cancellation lines exist and should be marked rather than silently mixed with sales.

Landed as VARCHAR with null_rate 0.0 and 2004 distinct values; every sample is an ISO-shaped datetime ('2009-12-01 07:45:00'), supporting a cast to TIMESTAMP; renamed to invoice_timestamp for snake_case clarity since values carry time of day.
Landed as DECIMAL(38,9) with null_rate 0.0; all samples have at most two decimal places (0.04, 0.12, 0.18) and max 1998.49 fits DECIMAL(10,2); min 0.0 shows zero-priced lines exist and are retained.

Landed as DECIMAL(38,9) but every sample is integral (12346.0, 12349.0) and min 12346.0 / max 18287.0 fit INTEGER; 13468 nulls (null_rate 0.29778) are retained as null because guest or unidentified transactions carry no customer.
Country name with null_rate 0.0 and only 24 distinct values; samples ('Australia', 'EIRE', 'Channel Islands') are plain text, kept as landed.
Airbyte capture metadata (is_airbyte_metadata true), one UUID per landed row (distinct_count 45228 equals row_count); dropped as a pipeline artifact with no business meaning.
Airbyte capture metadata (is_airbyte_metadata true) with only 2 distinct extraction timestamps one second apart; dropped as a pipeline artifact.
Airbyte capture metadata (is_airbyte_metadata true) whose single distinct value is the empty object '{}'; dropped as a pipeline artifact carrying no information.

decisions.rationale: The profile reports row_count 45228 with duplicate_row_rate 0.011188 (roughly 506 rows); rows identical across all eight business columns are collapsed to one, since the Airbyte raw id is the only thing distinguishing them in bronze.

Invoice (2330 distinct) and stock_code (3141 distinct) are both null-free and together form the smallest plausible line-item grain after exact dedupe; a reviewer should measure this against the warehouse since repeated item lines within one invoice at different prices would violate it.
customer_id has 13468 nulls (null_rate 0.29778); these rows are kept with null retained because dropping nearly 30% of transactions or imputing an id would distort revenue analysis.
quantity has min -1395.0 and negative samples throughout; negative-quantity lines are kept and marked with the derived is_return boolean so consumers can include or exclude returns deliberately.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are flagged is_airbyte_metadata in the profile and carry no business meaning (_airbyte_meta is uniformly '{}'); all three are dropped.
price has min 0.0, so zero-priced lines exist in bronze; they are retained because the profile gives no basis to treat them as errors, and consumers can filter them.

description samples show leading/trailing and doubled internal spaces (' BROWN  PIRATE TREASURE CHEST '); values are kept exactly as landed since trimming is a normalization choice the reviewer should confirm.

purpose: silver_online_retail_ii is the cleaned line-item view of the bronze online_retail_ii capture: one row per invoice line after exact-duplicate removal, with typed quantity, price, timestamp, and customer id, feeding downstream sales, returns, and customer analyses.
usage: Read one row as one invoice line at the declared invoice plus stock_code grain. Filter is_return = false to analyze sales only, since return lines (negative quantity) are retained and flagged rather than excluded. Expect customer_id to be null on roughly 30% of rows and zero prices on some lines; handle both deliberately rather than assuming completeness.
limitations: Exact duplicate rows (duplicate_row_rate 0.011188 of 45228 rows) are collapsed without distinguishing true re-entries from capture repeats. customer_id is null on 29.778% of rows and no imputation is attempted. description nulls (null_rate 0.005041) and its untrimmed whitespace are preserved as landed. Zero prices (min 0.0) and negative quantities are retained; the grain of invoice plus stock_code is declared from profile evidence and must be measured against the warehouse before approval.
